call_unit: logical calls including route, spawn, worker, review and continuation-control calls
continuation: After every actual verification, ask the pilot to continue or stop with public reason; retain prior artifacts and results; continuation starts a fresh pass under the SAME global logical-call budget and owner-authorized spend ceiling. No separate pass-count limit.

current_pilot_pa2.byte_bound: wire_utf8_bytes + requested_completion_tokens + 8192 <= declared route window; conditional byte-token/rendering premises
current_pilot_pa2.historical_current_pilot: The earlier current_pilot object is retained as the P-A1 observation.
current_pilot_pa2.input_contract: content-addressed task and participant-source units; compact spawn refs; scoped bounded reads; exact wire preflight
current_pilot_pa2.preserved_contract: P-A1 budgets, continuation/stop, checker sandbox and lineage unchanged
current_pilot_pa2.remaining_limits: Offline host qualification only; native provider manifest and semantic usefulness untested; UC1 combined static verification plus review remains separate.

envelope.input_tokens: Additional and unknown until request/provider accounting. If independently certified <=64000 per attempt, conditional prompt envelope <=38400000 for 600 attempts, and combined <=43315200. The current pilot does not enforce this 64000 premise. It is an estimate, not a new task token cap.

opening_pilot_observation: CLI max-calls counts attempts, defaults24 and rejects >24. task.json has no supported max_calls field. This sidecar and public task instruction state owner intent; current launcher does not consume this sidecar. Never report it as enforced.
sealed_material: briefs and READING are reader-only, never worker context; allowlist exact task inputs only.
stop_rule: Pilot STOP: its own stated substantive completion rule or concrete inability/tool/evidence blocker. Host resource stop: global logical-call ceiling, owner-authorized spend ceiling, or missing usable priced usage. Distinguish them and leave unresolved work visible.
